title: Stringize with Double Expansion
prompt: Given the classic wrapper pair already in your editor (`STR_` and `STR`) and a file-scope `#define BUILD_ID 77`, implement `const char *id_string(void)` returning STR(BUILD_ID) — the expanded value as text — and `const char *id_raw(void)` returning what STR_(BUILD_ID) yields: the bare token name.

tests.name: double expansion stringizes the value
tests.hint: STR(BUILD_ID) first expands BUILD_ID to 77, then stringizes it: the result is the text 77.

tests.name: single expansion keeps the name
tests.hint: STR_ never expands its argument, so the string is the bare token name.
